basic_info.description: This high-floor, bright and large view unit has been designed and furnished by an interior designer.  The open kitchen features top of the line cabinetry and appliances and full-slab marble countertops. The primary en-suite bedroom includes a large spa-like bath with soaking tub, glass enclosed shower, and walk-in closet. The second full bathroom is conveniently located down the hall by the living room. A laundry room and an adjacent large closet completes the layout. There is additional secure storage for the unit on the same floor in a storage room down the hall. Amenities include 24/7 luxury hotel grade arrival team (door staff, desk attendant, security, porters, and valet parkers), 20,000 square feet fitness and Pilates center, saline lap pool, screening room, owners' lounge, landscaped outdoor terrace with multiple fire pits, wine storage (unit has its private wine locker), private dining room, & children's playroom. Following multiple years of construction, 301 Mission is now connected to bedrock.Parking available short term or monthly in the building through the valet desk.Vacant unit.
